scope: Native PCM and emitted-path checks. No physical listening claim.
checks: Camera-right reverses both interaural delays and ear levels without moving source or simulation
Two outlets share the source budget and equal the sum of separately propagated half-level outlets
Invalid coordinates, zero head axis, duplicate IDs and amplified outlet sums are rejected
Every body has matching outlet count and coordinates, pitch/roll alter anchors, and detached-wheel positions are not used as body points
Chase and hood retain actual camera height and position; overhead microphone remains at most 5.5 metres away
Separate outlet image sources yield source-dependent facade delays; disabling reverb removes reflection energy
Scene rendering changes audible PCM while preserving exact engine time and physical state
GameAudio uses one renderAudio call per frame block, preserves world anchors and emits finite limited PCM
